items.subject: Summary of failures for Google Apps Script: Gemini Email Triage
items.summary: The Gemini Email Triage script reported 96 failures because the processInbox function could not be found; its 15-minute trigger has been failing since 16 September 2026 and was still failing on 17 September.
items.action: Open the Google Apps Script project directly, restore or rename the missing processInbox function or update/remove the obsolete trigger that calls it, then run a manual test and confirm the 15-minute trigger completes successfully.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether to restore the processInbox function or repoint/remove the obsolete trigger.
